column3: The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here; BSB names Josiah.
The Hebrew uses an active plural, “they tore down”; BSB uses the passive.
The Hebrew continues with a list of locations; BSB explicitly supplies “Josiah did the same.”
The Hebrew says “the house” and leaves the sender unnamed here; BSB says “the temple” and names Josiah.
The Hebrew ends with “they returned to Jerusalem”; BSB adds the people of Jerusalem to the sources of the collection.
The Hebrew says the kings of Judah ruined the buildings; BSB says they allowed them to deteriorate.
The Hebrew says “by the hand of Moses”; BSB explicitly says “written by Moses.”
The Hebrew repeats the name Hilkiah and “the book”; BSB uses “he” and “it.”
The Hebrew leaves the speaker unnamed here and says “who sent you to me”; BSB names Huldah and omits “to me.”
The Hebrew says “they read” the book; BSB uses the passive.
The Hebrew says “your graves,” in the plural; BSB says “your grave.”
The Hebrew orders the description “from great to small”; BSB says “small and great.”
